# HashBuilds

> > HashBuilds is a technical resource and consultancy focused on LLM-first development, MVP architecture, and production-ready Next.js applications with Claude Code, Prisma, and TypeScript.

HashBuilds provides expert guidance on modern web development stacks optimized for AI-assisted coding workflows. The site offers technical tutorials, design pattern documentation, and consulting services for founders building production MVPs with Next.js, Prisma, and Claude Code.

## Key Topics

- Next.js
- Claude Code
- Prisma
- TypeScript
- MVP Development
- Next.js 14 App Router
- PostgreSQL
- Vercel
- WebSockets
- Content Security Policy (CSP)
- Server Actions
- Programmatic SEO
- Platform Deployment
- LLM-First Development
- Production Architecture
